status: Proposed implementation; owner authorized eight Ogres plus a replacement Machine and a GitHub PR

champions.shape: broad ochre-skinned ogre with a blunt square jaw, tiny lower tusks, one massive upright faceted basalt shield strapped to the left forearm, short stone knuckle on right fist, bare cropped head, compact charcoal leather harness; equipment hugs body
champions.kit: Stone chips erupt on heavy unit hits; durable single frontline, no healing
champions.branch_a: stone shield stacks upward, slate shoulder cap and pale face stripe
champions.branch_b: cracked dark shield, copper arm wraps and amber fissures
champions.kit_pt: Golpes retiram uma parcela limitada da vida máxima do alvo.

champions.shape: stocky brick-red ogre with low coal-black brow, two short square-headed iron forge hammers held vertically near ribs, asymmetric leather apron and small glowing coals in a rear basket, no guns
champions.kit: Every third completed hit sends a compact cinder sweep into nearby enemies
champions.branch_a: one tall double-faced hammer, pale forged plates and upright coal crown
champions.branch_b: twin charcoal hammers with orange cracks, oxblood apron and iron collar
champions.kit_pt: A cada terceiro golpe, espalha brasas entre inimigos próximos.

champions.shape: lean slate-green ogre, hooked iron right gauntlet, tight chain coiled around left forearm, asymmetric short dark teal coat, one chipped tusk and wrapped head, chain remains compact; no anchor or giant shoulder pole
champions.kit: A precise hook strike gains damage against wounded foes; no forced movement
champions.branch_a: single polished tall hook and cream rope sash
champions.branch_b: double inward hooks, dark iron chain loops and copper collar
champions.kit_pt: Causa mais dano a inimigos com menos de 30% de vida.

champions.shape: tall wiry sand-colored ogre with long wrapped legs, forward neck and two small chipped obsidian cleavers held close to hips, swept-back white hair crest, rust-orange short mantle, no shield or firearm
champions.kit: Walking charges the next hit; fast flanking silhouette without teleportation
champions.branch_a: long pale flint blade and white leather shoulder mantle
champions.branch_b: paired black obsidian cleavers with amber mineral edges and rust wraps
champions.kit_pt: Caminhar carrega um golpe mais forte, consumido no contato.

champions.shape: heavy muted umber ogre with round ochre ceramic face mask, a tall narrow clay jar strapped vertically on back, left hand shaping a small floating earth clod, right hand short crooked stone rod, dry cream layered skirt, no foliage
champions.kit: Periodic earth pulse and slowing clay keep compact groups in place
champions.branch_a: ivory sealed mask, stacked dry clay shoulder plates and angular earth rod
champions.branch_b: dark glazed mask, ochre cracked jar and mineral glow
champions.kit_pt: Retarda inimigos e marca o solo antes de um pulso de terra.

champions.shape: round olive ogre with swept ivory hair, a single tall cylindrical hide drum suspended vertically in front of abdomen, two stubby bone mallets held near drum rim, narrow brown fur collar; drum stays within shoulders, no shield
champions.kit: Timed drum shock interrupts hostile special-ability windups; ordinary attacks remain intact, with readable anticipation and counterplay
champions.branch_a: pale skin drum face, upright horn resonator and cream fur
champions.branch_b: black drum body with copper hoops, twin short wind pipes and ochre wraps
champions.kit_pt: Interrompe habilidades especiais; os ataques básicos continuam.

champions.shape: warm gray-green ogre medic with round spectacles, patchwork tan leather shoulder cape, large carved bone sewing needle in right hand, thick amber thread spool carried vertically on back, a stitched leather satchel at left hip; no cooking equipment, no wings
champions.kit: Stitches apply several small healing pulses; feet stable for rear allies
champions.branch_a: cream stitched mantle and ivory needle with small brass loop
champions.branch_b: dark patchwork cape, larger amber spool with pale thread halo
champions.kit_pt: Aplica curas periódicas que cessam quando o aliado sofre dano.

champions.shape: small hunched blue-gray ogre with large ears, a compact upright Y-shaped wooden slingshot in right hand and a leather stone pouch in left, gravel satchel on back, mustard vest and dark wrapped feet, angular bald crown
champions.kit: Aimed pebbles punish an enemy committing to an attack; active timing cue
champions.branch_a: tall pale reinforced fork, counterweight and cream stone sack
champions.branch_b: double leather pouch, black mineral stones and orange bindings
champions.kit_pt: O terceiro disparo ganha força contra um inimigo preparando ataque.

champions.shape: compact upright medieval clockwork ballista automaton with two long bent iron legs and broad brass feet, faceted ivory wedge head, narrow forward bolt rail gripped by jointed arms, vertical rivet magazine rising behind head, warm brass chest and dark iron pelvis; no ogre skin, wheels, cannon or drill
champions.kit: Every third rivet pierces one target behind; precise replacement for Machines ranged slot
champions.branch_a: long cream rail, vertical sight fin and pale steel armor
champions.branch_b: triple upright magazine, black iron housing and copper feed gear
champions.kit_pt: A cada terceiro disparo, um rebite perfura um inimigo atrás do alvo.
